verdict.one_line_summary: Small-molecule QEE/QCC results match; defect/hardware left untested
verdict.justification: Replication directly probed five enumerated methodological claims (C1–C5) on H2, LiH, BeH2 and H2O. Qubit-count compression (C1,C4) matched authors’ formula (e.g., LiH 8 vs 12 qubits); QEE Hamiltonians reproduced PySCF FCI energies to <1e-14 Ha (C5). QCC with gradient-screened entanglers recovered FCI for H2 along the full dissociation curve using just two entanglers (max |ΔE| = 1.6×10⁻¹⁵ Ha), confirming C2 and the screening mechanism (C3) on this benchmark. Extension to LiH showed larger residual error, consistent with authors’ statements. Spin-defect systems, hardware runs, and zero-noise extrapolation were not attempted, leaving a significant part of the paper untested. Thus replication covers ~80 % of core methodological claims with high agreement, but full study not reproduced.
